method: All 30 URLs below were fetched with a declared read-only user agent to a temporary directory, rendered together, and visually inspected. No image binary was added to the repository. Each source URL, image URL, creator, license, dimensions, and SHA-1 are the exact fields in its stated catalog record; catalog IDs are immutable lookup keys for that provenance.

admissionNotes: Do not infer any behavior beyond what the visible field says. A pair may be described as mating only where the source title identifies it that way.
Do not infer a character identity, exact location, diet, or emotional state from these photographs.
Before runtime admission, resolve every catalog ID and reread the live Commons source page for any taxonomy or licensing change.
